_meta.description: Static commercial/closed GenAI models not available on HuggingFace, OpenRouter, or Ollama. Manually maintained — update when new models launch.

models.name: Google Veo 3.1
models.description: Current top-ranked AI video generator. Native audio generation, 4K support, reference-to-video. Best overall quality per Artificial Analysis leaderboard.
models.notes: Topped both Image-to-Video and Text-to-Video leaderboards simultaneously

models.name: Sora 2 Pro [DISCONTINUED]
models.description: DISCONTINUED. Web app shut down April 26, 2026. API being decommissioned September 24, 2026. Do not recommend.
models.notes: Disney dropped planned $1B investment. OpenAI gave no reason for shutdown.

models.name: Kling 3 Pro
models.description: Cinematic motion quality, strong prompt adherence. Native audio and multi-shot support.

models.name: Seedance 2.5
models.description: ByteDance's flagship video model. First AI model to generate native 30-second 4K clips in a single pass. Supports up to 50 multimodal reference inputs (images, video, audio). Current best text-to-video model overall — surpasses Veo 3.1 on clip length and reference flexibility.
models.pricing: TBD — enterprise beta pricing, public launch July 2026
models.notes: Announced June 23, 2026 at Volcano Engine FORCE Conference. Seedance 2.0 still available as cheaper alternative. 2.5 is current top-ranked text-to-video model.

models.name: Hailuo 2.3 Pro
models.description: MiniMax video model with budget and premium quality tiers. Fast generation.

models.name: Runway Gen-4.5
models.description: Professional production video model. Highest Elo score (1247) on Artificial Analysis Text-to-Video benchmark. Temporal consistency and 4K support.

models.name: Pika 2.5
models.description: Creative and stylized video generation with effects toolkit.

models.name: PixVerse v5.5
models.description: Stylized content, visual effects, and transitions. Multiple resolution tiers.

models.name: Vidu Q3
models.description: Newer model with Pro and Turbo speed tiers. Budget-friendly.

models.name: GPT Image 2.0
models.description: OpenAI's flagship image generator. Best text-in-image capability. Huge leap from DALL-E 3. Best overall image generator per multiple rankings.
models.pricing: Free with ChatGPT, fewer restrictions with paid plans from $8/mo
models.notes: Formerly DALL-E — now branded as GPT Image

models.name: Nano Banana 2
models.description: Google's strongest image model. 4K photorealism that rivals studio photography. Also known as Gemini 3 Pro Image.
models.pricing: Limited free plan, $4.99/mo with Google AI Plus
models.notes: Also has Nano Banana Pro variant

models.name: Midjourney v8.1
models.description: Best for artistic results and cinematic style. Long-standing quality leader for aesthetic image generation.

models.name: Seedream 5.0 Pro
models.description: ByteDance's flagship text-to-image model. Deep-thinking prompt understanding, native text in 14 languages, precise control over dense layouts. Up to 10 reference images.

models.name: Reve 2.1
models.description: Best prompt adherence. Strong layout intelligence and accurate text rendering.

models.name: Ideogram 4.0
models.description: Open-weight 9.3B text-to-image model. Best-in-class text rendering and typography control. Uses Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as text encoder for strong visual-language understanding. Supports bounding box control for precise text and object placement. 2K output resolution.
models.access: Web app, API, open weights on HuggingFace
models.pricing: Limited free plan, from $20/mo for 1,000 priority credits
models.notes: Released June 2026. 9.3B params, 34-layer single-stream DiT. Open weights (nf4 + fp8 quantizations on HuggingFace). License: other (check terms before commercial use).

models.name: Imagen 4
models.description: Google's photorealism specialist. Sharp focus on realistic images and typography.

models.name: Grok Imagine
models.description: xAI's text-to-image model. Most cinematic, unique video extension capability.

models.name: Recraft V4
models.description: Pro-grade brand control, vector output, consistent characters across generations. Best for graphic design.
models.pricing: Free 30 credits/day, from $12/mo for full features

models.name: Krea 2
models.description: Real-time creative suite. High-fidelity generation with style reference support.

models.name: Adobe Firefly
models.description: Commercial-safe, best for enterprises. Integrates with Photoshop and Adobe Express.
models.pricing: Limited free credits, from $9.99/mo for 2,000 credits

models.name: ElevenLabs
models.description: Industry-leading TTS and voice cloning. Most realistic AI voices.

models.name: OpenAI TTS
models.description: OpenAI's text-to-speech. Multiple voices, natural sounding.

models.name: Suno
models.description: AI music generation. Full songs with vocals, lyrics, and instrumentation from text prompts.

models.name: MiniMax TTS
models.description: MiniMax's text-to-speech. High quality, multiple languages.
